notes.text: Stated rewrite: approved comp drifted to transit marketing; surface brief requires Riffle product content with spatial layout as law.

reasons: region status-block is missing (detail 7%, structure 75%): the comp shows material the build does not

region map-callout (control) is contradicted (structure 38%, detail added 23%): this control differs from the comp: inspect its lettering and visible shape separately against the crop and the measured readings; preserve the region's control classification

control hero-ctas drifts to 62% (structure 66%, color 79%): open .impeccable/review/diff/hero/regions/hero-ctas.png and compare its lettering and visible shape separately; use the measured readings and preserve the region's control classification
region hero-ctas: its ink sits in a 323x39px box in the comp and 263x47px in the build (padding, row height, or size); match the box, not only the position

Drawings, diagrams, notation, and leader lines are plates or belong to the plate they annotate; only icon-sized SVG (under 64px, a few paths) is code

text hero-ctas: letter-spacing is tighter than the comp's (gap 0.022 vs 0.077 of the cap height); set letter-spacing to open it by about 2px
text status-block: ink is #349ed3 in the build, #939698 in the comp; use the comp's colour
text hero-ctas: ink is #0875c8 in the build, #09a8eb in the comp; use the comp's colour
text popular-list: ink is #5ca1dc in the build, #b8bbbf in the comp; use the comp's colour
